headline: 今日零新片，《蜘蛛侠》登顶热议
headlineEn: Zero New Films Today, Spider-Man Tops Buzz
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周共4部新片。热议榜由《最后孤屋》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《奥德赛》等领跑，下周将迎来《最后的日出》《OK老板娘2》等新作。
summaryEn: No new films released today; four debut this week. Trending is led by The Last Lonely House, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, The Odyssey, with The Last Sunrise and OK Boss Lady 2 arriving next.

industryHighlights.text: 今日0部新片上映，市场等待新一轮爆发。
industryHighlights.en: Zero new releases today; the market waits for the next burst.

industryHighlights.text: 本周共4部新片入场，供给保持平稳。
industryHighlights.en: Four new titles hit theaters this week, keeping supply steady.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》持续领跑本周趋势榜。
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day continues to lead the weekly trend chart.

industryHighlights.text: 《最后的日出》《OK老板娘2》《逃出绝命街》备受期待。
industryHighlights.en: The Last Sunrise, OK Boss Lady 2, and Escape from Dead End Street are highly anticipated.
